nodes.label: Tavla Mark (White)
nodes.description: White (#FFFFFF) monochrome Tavla logo mark, viewBox 582x578: a dot (circle) top-right, a wide rounded horizontal bar, and a vertical stem with rounded bottom, forming a stylized lowercase 't' with a dot.
nodes.rationale: Single-color white variant intended for use on dark or colored backgrounds (e.g. dark headers, footers, hero overlays).
